# 🚀 Nuvio Enhanced iOS v0.4.13

- Indefinite background downloads via background audio keep-alive
- Native interactive iOS folder picker (UIDocumentPickerViewController)
- Reliable local notifications, haptics & audio chimes for LiveContainer & SideStore
- Immediate Files app discovery (.keep file initialization)
- Startup coordinators & notification center activation
